Medical billing support.

A Pakistan-based operations team supports billing for US practices in partnership with SuperBillOne LLC.

Discuss this service View brief

Scope of work.

Submit and reconcile

The team checks charge entries before submission, resolves rejected claims, posts payments and reconciles payments against deposits.

Follow up on open claims

Worklists prioritise unpaid accounts by age and value. Payer contacts and appeal activity are documented so your team can follow individual claims.

See the monthly picture

A named contact reviews days in accounts receivable, denial trends and collections. The report includes actions for the next month.

What you receive.

  • Sample billing and receivables review to agree the starting point.
  • Pilot workflow inside your billing system where compatible.
  • Monthly collections, denial and receivables report with action items.

US healthcare operations.

We coordinate US billing with SuperBillOne LLC in Austin, Texas.

Meet the billing partner

Common questions.

Is the service intended for Pakistani or US providers?

The main client group is US practices. A Pakistani provider can enquire and the team will assess whether the service fits its needs.

How are the fees structured?

A per-claim arrangement or a percentage of collections may suit the work. Claim volume and payer mix inform the written proposal.

How does a new engagement begin?

The team favours a short pilot so both sides can evaluate the workflow before confirming a wider agreement.
